title: DAY 2 — LESSON 5: SEPARATING PERSONAL FEELINGS FROM PROFESSIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES

questions.prompt: What does separating personal feelings from professional responsibilities mean?
options: Managing your behaviour so personal feelings do not unfairly interfere with work
Hiding every personal problem from management

questions.prompt: You are upset with a colleague, but she needs important appointment information. What should you do?
options: Refuse because you are not speaking to her
Wait until she apologises, even if the appointment is delayed

questions.prompt: A therapist feels too distressed to concentrate safely on a session. What is the best response?
options: Continue without telling anyone regardless of the risk
Notify the appropriate supervisor and seek assistance or an adjustment

questions.prompt: A supervisor excuses a friend's mistakes but penalises others for similar mistakes. What is the problem?
options: Personal friendship is interfering with professional fairness
Employees should never be friends with supervisors

questions.prompt: Which statement about emotional maturity is correct?
options: It means recognising emotions and choosing appropriate responses
It means never disagreeing with management
It means pretending that problems do not exist
